mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM voucher v WHERE v.code = #{voucherCode})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO voucher(code, voucher_condition, description, discount_price, end_time, start_time, total_quantity, created_at, updated_at, is_active) VALUES (#{voucherInfo.code}, #{voucherInfo.condition}, #{voucherInfo.description}, #{voucherInfo.discountPrice}, #{voucherInfo.endTime}, #{voucherInfo.startTime}, #{voucherInfo.totalQuantity}, NOW(), NOW(), true)
mapper.select: SELECT v.id as id, v.code as code, v.voucher_condition as voucherCondition, v.description as description, v.discount_price as discountPrice, v.end_time as endTime, v.start_time as startTime, v.total_quantity as totalQuantity, v.used_quantity as usedQuantity, v.is_active as isActive FROM voucher v

SELECT v.id as id, v.code as code, v.voucher_condition as voucherCondition, v.description as description, v.discount_price as discountPrice, v.end_time as endTime, v.start_time as startTime, v.total_quantity as totalQuantity, v.used_quantity as usedQuantity, v.is_active as isActive FROM voucher v WHERE v.start_time >= NOW() AND v.end_time <= NOW() AND v.is_active = true

SELECT v.id as id, v.code as code, v.voucher_condition as voucherCondition, v.description as description, v.discount_price as discountPrice, v.end_time as endTime, v.start_time as startTime, v.total_quantity as totalQuantity, v.used_quantity as usedQuantity, v.is_active as isActive FROM voucher v WHERE v.id = #{voucherId}

SELECT v.id as id, v.code as code, v.voucher_condition as voucherCondition, v.description as description, v.discount_price as discountPrice, v.end_time as endTime, v.start_time as startTime, v.total_quantity as totalQuantity, v.used_quantity as usedQuantity, v.is_active as isActive FROM voucher v WHERE v.code = #{voucherCode} AND v.is_active = true
mapper.update: UPDATE voucher SET code = #{voucherInfo.code}, voucher_condition = #{voucherInfo.condition}, description = #{voucherInfo.description}, discount_price = #{voucherInfo.discountPrice}, end_time = #{voucherInfo.endTime}, start_time = #{voucherInfo.startTime}, total_quantity = #{voucherInfo.totalQuantity}, updated_at = NOW() is_active = #{voucherInfo.isActive} WHERE id = #{voucherId}
